name: localix
description: Bundled Localix plugins — the reference set shipped with the app.

plugins.name: api
plugins.description: Build, save, import, parameterize, and send HTTP requests with vault-backed secret references.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: battleship
plugins.description: Battleship against the agent, one game per chat: each side fires in turn, and the agent answers every shot with its own tool without ever seeing your fleet.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: checkers
plugins.description: Checkers (Russian draughts) against the agent, one board per chat: the agent in that chat answers each move with its own tool, and the board goes when the chat does.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: chess
plugins.description: Chess against the agent, one board per chat: the agent in that chat answers each move with its own tool, and the board goes when the chat does.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: code-graph
plugins.description: A navigable map of the project's code: directories, files and symbols with their imports, calls and inheritance, built locally with tree-sitter and queryable by the agent.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: database
plugins.description: Browse schemas, run queries, inspect data, and attach database context across supported engines.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: deliverable
plugins.description: Attach files named in a final response as inline media or downloadable deliverables.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Inspect local containers and Kubernetes resources through a shared operations workspace.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: documents
plugins.description: Read, create, inspect, and attach document, spreadsheet, presentation, PDF, and table content.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: game-2048
plugins.description: Play 2048 in a chat, or choose the agent to play the same board with its own tool.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: git-workspace
plugins.description: A first-class Git workspace for changes, conflicts, history, branches, review context, and agent-assisted source-control workflows.
plugins.author: localix

plugins.name: kanban
plugins.description: A passive task board per chat: epics, tasks, dependencies, checklists, owners and blockers, kept by you and the agent in that chat. The board records work; it never starts it.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: learning
plugins.description: File-authored course bundles with Markdown lessons, independent multi-tab study, durable progress, and resource-based agent context.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: project-space
plugins.description: One spatial board per project: notes, shapes, frames, sequence diagrams, code snippets and connectors beside live references to the project's files, folders, images and documents, kept in the project and edited by you and the agent, which can also move your camera to show you a part of it.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: reader
plugins.description: Focused local reader for explicitly opened EPUB, PDF, MOBI/AZW3, FB2, CBZ, Markdown, HTML, and text with native agent context and links.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: resume
plugins.description: Structured resumes with a shared editor, revision-safe agent tools and section context.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Run a scoped diff review and file prioritized inline suggestions.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: rock-paper-scissors
plugins.description: Rock paper scissors against the agent, one table per chat: whoever moves first seals the move, and the round reveals both with a digest anyone can check.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: template
plugins.description: OS, CPU and memory history with process inspection and agent context.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: tic-tac-toe
plugins.description: Tic-tac-toe against the agent, one board per chat: the agent in that chat answers each move with its own tool, and the board goes when the chat does.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: trading
plugins.description: Read-only market research workspace for venues, charts, indicators, order books, and trades; no account or order path.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: webhook-notifier
plugins.description: Send selected lifecycle events to a webhook with optional HMAC-SHA256 signing.
plugins.author: Localix

plugins.name: workflows
plugins.description: Turn a free-form goal into a team: the agent plans tasks on the Kanban board, brings in the specialists it needs and coordinates them to the result.
plugins.author: Localix
